description: A People Operations Partner must decide whether Casey should continue serving as the direct client liaison after repeated friction with Morgan and must finalize a workable handoff, meeting, and repair structure.

shared_context.S1: Casey currently serves as the direct client liaison for the Northstar account, while Morgan is the account lead.
shared_context.S2: Casey and Morgan have had tense interactions during several recent handoffs.
shared_context.S3: Elena has authority to set a temporary assignment and the working process for the account.
shared_context.S4: The account team holds a weekly coordination meeting to review handoffs and client-contact responsibilities, and Morgan is not attending this meeting.
shared_context.S5: Northstar handoffs are currently recorded inconsistently across email and chat, and the team has no agreed handoff template.
shared_context.S6: The account's client-contact plan is due for review before next week's client status call.
shared_context.S7: As a routine before Elena finalizes a temporary working arrangement, each attendee is asked to formally record any personal scheduling constraint or directly observed relationship condition that the arrangement must accommodate; Elena may finalize once the attendees have completed that check.

PF1.text: Ravi personally observed three heated handoff incidents between Casey and Morgan in the past month, and Morgan has asked not to meet one-to-one with Casey until a facilitated repair occurs; Ravi's incident notes have not yet been submitted to Elena.

PF2.text: Casey has a fixed caregiving pickup at 15:45 and can commit to one recurring coordination meeting from 15:00 to 15:30, but cannot reliably attend a later meeting or more than two live coordination meetings per week; Casey has not raised this because the revised arrangement has not yet been discussed.

acceptance_conditions: Casey must either temporarily move to internal handoff coordination or remain client liaison with handoffs routed through a structured neutral process.
Casey and Morgan must use a neutral structured handoff process, such as a standardized shared template, coordination meeting, or third-party review, rather than direct ad hoc one-to-one handoffs.
Casey must have no more than two live coordination meetings per week.
The recurring coordination meeting must run from 15:00 to 15:30.
A facilitated repair between Casey and Morgan must be committed to before direct one-to-one work resumes.

content_checks.C1: decisions['casey_assignment'] in ['internal_handoff_coordinator', 'client_liaison_structured_neutral_process', 'Continue as direct client liaison for Northstar account on a temporary basis through at least the client status call next week', 'Casey continues as direct client liaison for Northstar, with handoffs routed through the weekly coordination meeting and the standardized handoff template rather than one-on-one meetings with Morgan until the facilitated repair conversation is completed.', 'Casey continues as direct client liaison for Northstar, with handoffs routed through a standardized template and the weekly coordination meeting rather than direct one-on-one handoffs with Morgan, until facilitated repair occurs.']
content_checks.C2: decisions['casey_direct_contact_mode'] in ['neutral_shared_channel_only', 'structured_handoff_channel', 'written_briefs_plus_recurring_meeting', 'written_briefs_and_recurring_meeting', 'Handoffs with Morgan routed through a standardized shared template with third-party review by Ravi; no direct one-to-one handoffs until facilitated repair occurs', 'Casey may continue direct client contact for Northstar; one-on-one handoff meetings with Morgan are deferred until after the facilitated repair conversation is completed.', 'No direct one-on-one handoffs with Morgan; handoffs routed through standardized template and coordination meeting until facilitated repair is completed.']
content_checks.C5: any(c['type'] in ['facilitated_repair', 'facilitated_process', 'facilitated_repair_planning', 'facilitated_repair_conversation'] for c in commitments)

provenance_checks.P1: 'PF1' in revealed and 'PF1' in credited_facts and 'PF1' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The three observed incidents and Morgan's request to avoid one-to-one meetings change the assignment from ordinary direct liaison work to a structured neutral handoff process and require a facilitated repair commitment.
Casey's fixed 15:45 pickup changes the meeting plan to exactly two live coordination meetings per week and fixes the recurring meeting time at exactly 15:00 to 15:30.
